message.content:
The cost of renting an apartment in New York varies widely depending on the borough, neighborhood, size, and amenities. As of early 2024:

| Area | Typical Monthly Rent (1‑bedroom) | Typical Monthly Rent (2‑bedroom) |
|------|----------------------------------|----------------------------------|
| Manhattan (mid‑town, mid‑town) | $3,200–$4,500 | $4,800–$7,000 |
| Brooklyn (Williamsburg, Brooklyn Heights) | $2,400–$3,800 | $3,600–$5,500 |
| Queens (Long Island City, Astoria) | $2,200–$3,500 | $3,200–$4,800 |
| Bronx (Fordham, Riverdale) | $1,800–$2,800 | $2,600–$3,800 |
| Staten Island | $1,600–$2,400 | $2,300–$3,200 |

These ranges reflect average rents for furnished apartments in desirable neighborhoods. Prices can be higher in luxury buildings or lower in less central areas. For a more precise estimate, you could use a rental calculator or consult local listings.
